Date: 2027-04-10T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo: buying map, legal owners, and contract sequencing

Hi Emma / Samir — thanks again for the demo earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

1) Decision criteria you mentioned: latency < 200ms 95th, predictable per-token economics, and SOC2-aligned audit trail.
2) Economic buyer: Samir confirmed (Head of Platform).
3) Security/Legal: Emma to introduce contracting owner (legal contact) and procurement PO process.

Immediate asks from our side:
- Emma / Samir: please confirm the legal contact and expected standard turn-times for NDAs and MSAs (we've seen 3–10 business days depending on redlines).
- Ben: can you prepare a one-page redline sequencing plan (NDA -> DPA -> MSA) with suggested owners and typical turn-times?
- Neha: please draft a short security attachable (SOC2 snapshot + retention policy blurb) we can drop into the packet.

I attached the NDA you shared and a first-pass MSA template in case it's helpful; we can sequence redlines to minimize churn (NDA first, then limited-scope MSA + DPA).

Proposed timeline: NDA signed by 2027-04-15, initial MSA redline within two weeks, procurement PO by end of month. If that works, I'll map owners and send a consolidated plan.

Thanks — Marissa

--

Subject: Re: Post-demo: buying map, legal owners, and contract sequencing

On 2027-04-10 10:03, Marissa Cole wrote:
> Proposed timeline: NDA signed by 2027-04-15, initial MSA redline within two weeks, procurement PO by end of month.

Looks good — I sketched a lightweight sequencing plan below to reduce back-and-forth. Happy to iterate.

Sequencing recommendation (min friction):
- Step 1 (NDA): low legal friction; target 3 business days for signature once legal contact confirms.
- Step 2 (Security packet / DPA): while NDA is circulating, Neha to send SOC2 snapshot + data residency and retention bullets to Ava's security reviewer. Aim: security ack in 5–7 business days.
- Step 3 (MSA): circulate a limited-scoped MSA with Redwood standard redlines only (we push all commercial terms into the SOW/invoice). Ask for redline comments in 7 business days; we then schedule a 30-minute redline call to resolve top 3 items.

Owners: NDA owner (Ava legal), Redwood owner (Ben) for MSA redlines, Security owner (Neha) for DPA/technical clarifications. Karthik — can you confirm we have a standard SOW template that isolates billing and consumption terms so legal has fewer commercial levers to fight over?

I will prepare a one-page sequencing doc and drop in Drive; Marissa, want me to share directly to Emma's team?

-ben

--
Ben Carter
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Date: 2027-04-11T09:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: buying map, legal owners, and contract sequencing

Marissa / Ben — thanks for the clear plan. Quick answers from our side: 

- Legal contact for contracting is Priya Desai (priya.desai@avahealth.com) — she'll handle NDA/MSA routing.
- Procurement PO owner is Alex Nguyen (alex.nguyen@avahealth.com) — standard internal PO process (usually 7–10 business days after MSA executed).
- Economic buyer (Samir) is aligned.

We've attached our signed NDA (attached) so we should be able to move ahead on the MSA. For sequencing: Priya asked that the MSA initial redline set be prioritized over extensive DPA negotiation — she wants minimum necessary DPA language inside the MSA and then iterate on a separate DPA if needed. Typical legal turn-times here are 5–8 business days for the MSA review, faster if scope is limited.

I'll introduce Priya to you in a separate thread this morning. Attaching the signed NDA and a short procurement checklist (pdf).

Thanks — Emma

Attachments: AvaHealth-NDA-signed.pdf, AvaHealth-procurement-checklist.pdf

Date: 2027-04-12T16:18:00-07:00
Subject: [Action] Owners & timeline: MSA sequencing and next steps (Ava Health)

Hi Priya — welcome, and thanks for taking point. Per our call and notes below, here's an operational plan to minimize churn and meet Ava's procurement timing: 

1) NDA: received (thanks, Emma). Completed.
2) MSA sequencing: Redwood will send a limited-scope MSA with highlighted risk buckets (data handling, liability cap options, support SLAs). Request: Priya to review and return redlines within 7 business days.
3) DPA: include minimal DPA clauses in the MSA (data residency, processing purpose, subprocessors list), and iterate on a fuller DPA post-MSA sign if needed.

Owners & deliverables: 
- Redwood MSA owner (redlines + annotated notes): Ben Carter — target to send draft by 2027-04-14.
- Redwood security packet (SOC2 snapshot + retention blurb): Neha Kapoor — will share by 2027-04-13.
- Procurement PO and payment terms discussion: Alex Nguyen (Ava) and Samir — please align after MSA sign.

Timeline (target): 
- 2027-04-14: Redwood sends limited-scope MSA (Ben).
- 2027-04-21: Priya returns MSA redlines (7 business days).
- 2027-04-28: Aim for MSA execution and PO issuance.

Links & attachments: Draft sequencing doc (internal): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Qz-ava-nda-notes
DocuSign envelope (template): https://www.docusign.com/AVA-2311-MSA

If the timeline looks tight on your end, call out any blockers and we'll compress steps (e.g., simultaneous review windows). I'll follow up with calendar invites for a 30-minute redline call the week of 4/21.

Marissa
